sentences.en: She put some money away every month for her retirement.
sentences.zh: 她每个月都存一些钱为退休做准备。

sentences.en: Half of all Norwegian women know nothing about their retirement.
sentences.zh: 挪威一半的女性对退休一无所知。

sentences.en: I have purchased eight acres of land for my retirement.
sentences.zh: 我购买了八英亩的土地为退休生活做打算。

senses.zh: 退休；退职；退役退休的实例退休生活；遁世，隐居
